none: PAS WMID-FC1F93: Roman coin, a copper-alloy as of Lucius Verus
contea di ritrovamento: Staffordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CAES L AVREL VERVS AVG ; R/ PROFECTIO AVG TR P III COS II/S C

A copper-alloy Roman as of Lucius Verus dating from Autumn to December 163 AD. Minted in Rome. Obverse legend: IMP CAES L AVREL VERVS AVG (Emperor bare headed facing right). Reverse legend: PROFECTIO AVG TR P III COS II/S C (Verus in military dress on a horse facing right, holding spear). RIC Volume III number 1356. Reece period 8
